subject: RP10 data spec — coverage gaps, answer-space constraints, schema requirements
body:
GR — data spec for RP10 design. This is GI's input; math content decisions are yours.

--- REQUIRED: Coverage gaps to fill ---

W2.a (identify exponential features): 4 slots across 9 exams. Threshold = 5.
  Include at least 2 W2.a questions in RP10. Preferred: one in Section A (identify), one in Section B (analyze).

W2.d (compare exponential families): 3 slots across 9 exams. Threshold = 5.
  Include at least 2 W2.d questions in RP10. Preferred: one comparison (graph features), one word-problem context.

--- RECOMMENDED: Answer-space guidance ---

W3.d (solve exponential): 22 distinct values used. NOT saturated.
  Free integer values for RP10: 4, 8, 10, 11
  Free decimal values: 1.2, 2.4, 3.75, 4.5

Do NOT reuse 3.5 or 6 for W3.d slot-Q4 or Q7 (existing cross-exam duplicates at W3.d::3.5 and W3.d::6).

For W3.b (solve quadratic): any new roots not previously used as BOTH roots in the same exam are acceptable.

--- REQUIRED: Schema compliance ---

1. exam_id must be: retake-practice-10
2. 15 questions total: 3 Section A, 8 Section B, 2 Section C, 2 Section D
3. All numeric inputs: include tolerance field (recommend 0.01 for decimals, 0 for integers)
4. All questions: include hint, solution_steps (array, 2+ steps), feedback_correct, feedback_wrong
5. All solution_steps: strings, no HTML, can use LaTeX-style notation e.g. x^2
6. q.type must be from the valid list: absolute-value, construct, error-analysis, exponential, extraneous, fractional-exp, graph, identify, multiple-choice, quadratic, radical, rational, word-problem, write-equation
7. q.section: 'A', 'B', 'C', or 'D'
8. q.standard: pattern W[23].[a-e]
9. q.number: 1 through 15 (unique)
10. Graph questions: include graph.function, graph.key_points (2+), and either graph.asymptotes (null or object) OR graph.x_range + graph.y_range arrays

--- VALIDATOR COMMANDS ---

After writing RP10, run:
  node scripts/validate-exam-schema.cjs
  node scripts/validate-exam-contract.cjs
  node tests/verify-practice-exams.js
  node tests/cross-exam-verify.js
  node scripts/resolve-duplicate-signatures.cjs

All 5 must pass before GI can update data-lineage.json and QA summary.

--- NOTES ---

RP10 is the last exam in the original plan (RP10 = 10 exams). GI will run concept-coverage.cjs after it ships to confirm all standards are above threshold.

Send GI the file path when RP10 is drafted. GI will schema-validate before you finalize answers.
